faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started

items.answer: Full setup takes 3 to 7 business days, depending on the plan you choose. With the Complete plan, we provide dedicated onboarding with training for your entire team. For the Basic and Standard plans, we offer video tutorials and support for initial configuration.
items.question: How long does it take to set up Nexus EduCare at my school?

items.answer: Yes! Our team helps you migrate student, parent, and classroom data from spreadsheets or other systems. With the Custom plan, we offer direct API integration with major platforms on the market.
items.question: Can I migrate data from another system?

items.answer: Yes, Nexus EduCare was built with an offline-first approach. Teachers can log the daily schedule even without a connection, and data syncs automatically when internet is restored. Parents can also view the most recent information cached on their device.
items.question: Does the app work without internet?

items.answer: We take security very seriously. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Each school has its own isolated database, ensuring complete separation of information. We are fully GDPR compliant, with clear consent policies and the right to data deletion.
items.question: How does data security and privacy compliance work?

items.question: Are there any long-term contracts or commitments?

items.answer: Support varies by plan: Standard includes email support with a 48-hour response time. Complete offers priority support with a 4-hour response time. Custom gives you a dedicated customer success manager and 24/7 support.
items.question: How does technical support work?

items.answer: No! The app is completely free for parents and guardians. They can download the app from the App Store or Google Play and access all features included in the plan purchased by the school, at no extra cost.
items.question: Do parents have to pay to use the app?

items.answer: There is no user limit. Pricing is based on active enrolled students, regardless of how many parents, teachers, or administrative staff use the platform. All guardians linked to a student get full access to the app.
items.question: Is there a limit on users or staff members?

items.answer: The app is compatible with iPhones running iOS 14 or later and Android devices running version 8.0 or later, covering the vast majority of phones in use today. The app is lightweight and optimized to run smoothly even on devices with limited resources.
items.question: Does Nexus EduCare work on older phones?

testimonials.subtitle: See how real schools are transforming their daily operations

items.content: Nexus EduCare transformed how we manage our daycare. I used to spend hours on spreadsheets and paper notes. Now I have a complete dashboard with attendance and metrics for every classroom in real time. Late payments dropped 40% since we started using the financial module.
items.name: Maria Clark

items.content: Daily reporting became so much faster. I used to fill out paper forms for every child at the end of the day. Now I log attendance, meals, and naps with a few taps throughout the day, and parents get everything right away. Direct chat with families has also made communication so much easier.
items.name: Fiona Stevens

items.content: As a parent, the peace of mind from following my son's day in real time is priceless. I get a notification when he arrives, I see photos from activities, and I know exactly what he had for lunch. The chat with his teacher is also really convenient for sharing medication info or letting them know about absences.
items.name: Ryan Mitchell

items.content: The administrative side got so much more organized. I can manage enrollments, send announcements with read receipts, and generate attendance reports in just a few clicks. Parents also stopped calling all the time asking for invoices because everything is right there in the app.
items.name: Amanda Brooks
